tickerText: [TENNIS] The Nitto ATP Finals draw placed Zverev in the John McEnroe Group with Shelton, Fils and Jodar while Alcaraz leads Ivan Lendl alongside Medvedev, Cobolli and Tiafoe ahead of Sunday's Turin opener • [SQUASH] PSA Silver last-eight pairings are set at the Pittsburgh Open after Makin, El Sherbini, Vargas and Withington won through, with Shanghai's Gold China Open following Nov 17 • [BADMINTON] The Kumamoto Masters Japan Super 500 continues through Nov 15 on a $500,000 prize fund as the season's late hard-court swing rolls on in Japan • [PICKLEBALL] Full pro draws are out for the Nov 16–22 Proton Daytona Beach Open at Pictona, where John Lucian Goins chases a third straight singles title • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Contender Istanbul's round of 32 is underway after Abdullah Yigenler upset Maksim Grebnev and Jessica Reyes Lai beat England's Tianer Yu in qualifying

newsItems.title: Turin Groups Set
newsItems.excerpt: Thursday's Nitto ATP Finals draw put No. 1 Alexander Zverev in the John McEnroe Group and Carlos Alcaraz atop the Ivan Lendl Group before indoor round-robin play begins Sunday in Turin.

newsItems.title: Pittsburgh Quarters
newsItems.excerpt: Joel Makin, Mohamed El Sherbini, Juan Camilo Vargas and Finnlay Withington reached the PSA Silver quarterfinals at the $96,000 Pittsburgh Open on Nov 12 ahead of Thursday's last-eight lineup.

newsItems.title: Daytona Draws Out
newsItems.excerpt: The Carvana PPA Tour released all five pro draws for the Proton Daytona Beach Open at Pictona Nov 16–22, a 1,000-point Open with more than $1 million in total payouts across divisions.

newsItems.title: Istanbul R32 Live
newsItems.excerpt: Men's singles round-of-32 play is rolling at WTT Contender Istanbul, where Abdullah Yigenler upset Maksim Grebnev 3-1 and Jessica Reyes Lai advanced past Tianer Yu after qualifying.
